note: Recorded before eval/roundtrace.py existed: this folder has no git state, host or Blender version. The code that produced it is the working tree on top of the commit named below. Base commit: 96b702e.
why: The 0.6B (R11) put the box at the coordinates of the hole or of the area, and the second hole fell in the void while the tool answered OK. Modeling is done at the origin and a part is moved only when it is finished, so the model must not be able to place the box.
changed: x, y, z hidden from create_box (the box is always at the origin) and rule 4 rewritten: everything is modeled at the origin.
